valid.name: trailing options object - already correct

valid.code: function foo(name: string, { a, b }: { a: string; b: number }) {}
valid.name: destructured param - never flag

valid.code: class Foo { bar(name: string, opts?: { x?: number; y?: string }) {} }
valid.name: method with options object

valid.code: const fn = (name: string, opts?: { a?: string }) => {};
valid.name: arrow with trailing options object

valid.code: function foo(name: string, { a, b } = { a: '', b: 0 }) {}
valid.name: destructured with default - never flag

valid.code: type Handler = (a: string, b?: number) => void;
valid.name: TSFunctionType with 0 or 1 optional params - fine

valid.code: function foo(name: string, age?: number, role?: string) {}
valid.name: minOptionals: 3 override - 2 optionals fall below the overridden threshold, fine

valid.code: function foo(name: string, age: number | undefined) {}
valid.name: single T | undefined union param - below threshold, fine
rest-tuple with a single optional member - below threshold, fine

invalid.code: function foo(name: string, age?: number, role?: string) {}
invalid.name: 2 standalone optional params - flag

invalid.code: function foo(a: string, b?: number, c?: boolean, d?: string) {}
invalid.name: mixed required and 2+ optionals - flag

invalid.code: const fn = (name: string, age?: number, role?: string) => {};
invalid.name: arrow function with 2 optionals - flag

invalid.code: function foo(a?: string, b?: number, c?: boolean) {}
invalid.name: 3 all-optional params - flag

invalid.code: type Handler = (a?: string, b?: string, c?: string) => void;
invalid.name: standalone TSFunctionType alias with 2+ optionals - flag

invalid.code: interface Foo { onEvent?: (a?: string, b?: string) => void; }
invalid.name: interface property signature typed as function with 2+ optionals - flag

invalid.code: function foo(a: string, b?: number, c?: boolean, d?: string) {}
invalid.name: minOptionals: 3 override - 3 optionals meet the overridden threshold, flag

invalid.code: function foo(name: string, age: number | undefined, role: string | undefined) {}
invalid.name: T | undefined union params with no '?' and no default still count as caller-omittable - flag

invalid.code: function foo(...args: [name?: string, age?: number, active?: boolean]) {}
invalid.name: rest-tuple param's own optional members count toward the threshold - flag

invalid.code: function foo(name: string, age?: number, role?: string, opts?: {}) {}
invalid.name: an empty {} type literal has no real type safety and is not accepted as the options object - flag

invalid.code: function foo(name: string, age?: number, role?: string, opts?: { [key: string]: unknown }) {}
invalid.name: a pure index-signature type literal is not accepted as the options object - flag
